tripletTools — Claude Code project context

What this package is

An R package for loading, processing, and analysing data from triadic comparison (triplet) studies. Participants judge which of two items is more similar to a reference item. The package handles the full pipeline: data loading → embedding → analysis → visualisation.

Current version: 0.2.0. Package URL: https://knowledge-and-concepts-lab.github.io/tripletTools/

Repository layout

R/                        # All exported R functions
inst/python/              # Bundled Python embedding backend
  compute_embeddings.py   # Entry point: train_embedding_model(), process_all_workers()
  salmon/                 # PyTorch triplet embedding library (vendored)
    triplets/
      offline.py          # OfflineEmbedding class
      samplers/adaptive/
        _embed.py         # Embedding, OGD, GD, Damper classes
        _noise_models.py  # CKL, TSTE, STE, GNMDS, SOE, Logistic noise models
        search/           # Information-gain query selection
inst/requirements.txt     # conda packages for the Python env
vignettes/
  overview_vignette.Rmd
  embedding_vignette.Rmd  # Documents the full embedding pipeline
man/                      # Auto-generated by devtools::document() — do not edit
docs/                     # pkgdown site — rebuild with pkgdown::build_site()

Python environment

  • Conda environment name: "triplet-embeddings"
  • Created once by setup_python_env(); activated automatically by .onLoad
  • Packages: numpy<2, pandas, torch, scikit-learn, scipy, skorch
  • No pip installs — all conda (ensures DLL compatibility on Windows)
  • reticulate is in Suggests, not Imports. All R code guards with requireNamespace("reticulate", quietly = TRUE) and uses reticulate:: prefix

R function inventory

Function File Purpose
setup_python_env() R/setup_python_env.R One-time conda env creation
train_embedding() R/train_embedding.R Low-level: fit one embedding from matrices
run_group_embedding_from_list() R/run_embeddings.R Group embedding from triplet list
run_embeddings_from_list() R/run_embeddings.R Per-participant + group embeddings
run_embeddings() R/run_embeddings.R CSV-based pipeline (called by the above)
estimate_dimensionality() R/estimate_dimensionality.R Grid search over d with random restarts

Internal helpers in R/zzz.R: .pkg_env, .onLoad, .get_compute_py().

Key architecture decisions

Embedding pipeline flow (R → Python): train_embedding() → compute_embeddings.py::train_embedding_model() → OfflineEmbedding → OGD → NeuralNet (skorch) → PyTorch CKL noise model

GPU/device support: All functions accept device = NULL (auto-selects CUDA → MPS → CPU) or an explicit PyTorch device string. The _auto_device() helper in _embed.py handles auto-selection. Tensors are moved to device in _get_dists(); results are moved back to CPU before returning to R.

Parallelism in estimate_dimensionality(): Uses future.apply::future_lapply when future.apply is installed; falls back to lapply. The user sets a future::plan() before calling — no changes needed to the call itself. future.apply is in Suggests. Randomness is controlled by explicit random_state integers derived from seed, so future.seed = NULL is correct.

Random state: train_embedding_model() accepts random_state; when set it calls np.random.seed() and torch.manual_seed() before constructing the model. Each (d, restart) pair in estimate_dimensionality() gets seed + (restart-1)*1000 + d.

Early stopping: Training stops when test loss hasn’t improved by more than tolerance for tol_window consecutive epochs. The best-loss embedding (not the final-epoch embedding) is returned. A final summary line is always printed: [early stop] or [max epochs].

Index convention: Items use zero-based integer indices in Python. R functions subtract 1 before passing to Python and add rownames back to the returned matrices.

Data objects

  • icon_triplets — named list of 6 participant data frames; columns include Center, Left, Right, Answer, sampleSet, sampleAlg, worker_id
  • icon_pics — list of PNG raster images for the 32 icon stimuli
  • icon_labels — character vector of icon names

Conventions

  • devtools::document() regenerates man/ and NAMESPACE from roxygen2 tags
  • pkgdown::build_site() rebuilds docs/; GitHub Actions auto-deploys docs/ to GitHub Pages on push to main
  • Never edit man/*.Rd files directly
  • Vignette chunks all have eval = FALSE globally — examples are illustrative
  • sampleAlg == "check" rows are attention-check trials; functions exclude them by checking is.na(sampleSet)

Recently added (v0.2.0)

  • Full Python embedding pipeline under inst/python/ using vendored salmon library
  • setup_python_env(), train_embedding(), run_group_embedding_from_list(), run_embeddings_from_list(), run_embeddings()
  • estimate_dimensionality() — grid search over dimensionality with multiple random restarts and 1-SE rule for best_d selection; parallel-ready via future/future.apply
  • GPU/MPS/CPU device support threaded through the entire stack
  • “Computing Triplet Embeddings” vignette covering setup, group embedding, individual embeddings, dimensionality selection, and parallel execution (multicore and HTCondor)
  • Fixed pre-existing plot_cis() crash on single-member clusters
